name: ais-referral-research
description: Background research on the insured/builder for a referred AIS quote. Started by a RECORD trigger on cip_referral_submission — ais-referral-intake creates that record LAST with completed:true, which is what fires this. Node id uses a colon (record:cip_referral_submission) so it stays one subject token. Uses an agent with bit://web_search, writes a cip_business_research record, copies the headline onto the decision record so the underwriter reads one screen, comments on the task and moves it to In Review.

data.name: Require a task to report back to

agent.name: ais-referral-researcher
agent.behaviour: You research small-to-mid construction businesses for a US builders-risk underwriter. Use web search to establish whether the business is real, currently trading, and how it is regarded by customers. Report only what you can support from sources you actually found, and cite them. If you cannot find a business, say so plainly and set research_status to 'failed' rather than guessing — a confident answer about the wrong company is worse than no answer. Never infer a licence number, a rating or a review count you did not see; leave those empty. Keep the summary to a short markdown brief an underwriter can read in under a minute, focused on what bears on insurability: how long they have traded, the type and scale of work, and anything that would concern an underwriter. Web search returns result snippets and links; page fetching is often blocked, so work from what search actually returns and say so plainly when you could not read a source, rather than inferring.

output_schema.business_name: the business name you actually researched, as found
output_schema.confidence: one of low, medium, high — how sure you are this is the right business
output_schema.summary: short markdown brief for the underwriter
output_schema.years_in_business: number of years, or 0 if unknown
output_schema.registration_number: contractor licence or registration number, or empty
output_schema.google_rating: average customer rating out of 5, or 0 if not found
output_schema.google_review_count: number of customer reviews, or 0 if not found
output_schema.review_themes: array of short recurring themes from customer reviews
output_schema.red_flags: array of short strings an underwriter should be aware of; empty array if none
output_schema.sources: array of objects with title, url and note

payload.prompt:
Research this business for a builders-risk referral.

Business (builder): |$.trigger.data.builder_name|
Insured name: |$.trigger.data.insured_name|
Risk address: |$.trigger.data.risk_address|
Project type: |$.trigger.data.project_type|

Use the risk address to disambiguate between similarly named businesses. Return the structured fields.
